name: goodvibes
description: The goodvibes platform with Jev judgment built in: the judgment foundation, the engine, and the daemon, TUI, agent and web UI products.

scripts.refresh:contracts: bun packages/engine/scripts/refresh-contract-artifacts.ts && bun packages/engine/scripts/generate-foundation-io-entries.ts && bun packages/engine/scripts/generate-openapi-contract.ts && bun packages/engine/scripts/generate-webui-facade.ts && bun packages/engine/scripts/generate-homeassistant-client.ts && bun packages/engine/scripts/refresh-product-contracts.ts && bun packages/engine/scripts/generate-api-docs.ts && bun packages/engine/scripts/generate-agent-spec.ts && bun packages/engine/scripts/generate-command-actions.ts
scripts.refresh:docs: bun run refresh:contracts && bun run docs:generate
scripts.api:extract: bunx api-extractor run --local --config packages/engine/api-extractor.json && bunx api-extractor run --local --config packages/engine/api-extractor.embed.json && bunx api-extractor run --local --config packages/engine/api-extractor.terminal-shell.json && bun packages/engine/scripts/normalize-api-eol.ts
scripts.api:check: bunx api-extractor run --config packages/engine/api-extractor.json && bunx api-extractor run --config packages/engine/api-extractor.embed.json && bunx api-extractor run --config packages/engine/api-extractor.terminal-shell.json && bun run api:subpath:check
scripts.release:verify: bun run validate && bun run security:audit && bun run release:dry-run

patchedDependenciesRationale.eslint-plugin-jsx-a11y@6.10.2: Adapt two legacy default imports to the named minimatch function while preserving the patched minimatch 11.x override and all accessibility rules. Bun 1.3.14 does not support scoped overrides; remove this patch when the plugin supports minimatch 11.x.
patchedDependenciesRationale.picomatch@4.0.7: Close GHSA-fc5q-39xc-vjpf (exponential backtracking from a glob star inside a repeated extglob such as +(*) or +(*a)); no picomatch release fixes it. Such an extglob is matched literally, as picomatch already does for the multi-branch forms. Used by vite, tinyglobby and fdir at build time. Remove when a fixed picomatch is released.
patchedDependenciesRationale.picomatch@2.3.2: The same fix for the 2.x line, used by the vendored Bash language server's file discovery and by vscode-markdown-languageservice. Remove when a fixed picomatch 2.x is released or its users move to a fixed line.

GHSA-fc5q-39xc-vjpf.reason: no fixed release; every installed picomatch is patched (patches/picomatch@*.patch), and no pattern from a page, a file or a model reaches picomatch at run time

overridesRationale.zod: Require 4.6.6 to close GHSA-mrhx-c7xc-m3w5 across existing Zod 4 consumers, including the compatible range retained by eslint-plugin-react-hooks. The vendored Bash server also uses 4.6.6, with its nested configuration defaults preserved during migration.
overridesRationale.sharp: Require 0.35.5 or later in the 0.35.x line to close GHSA-wq5f-xc86-pv6w (librsvg CVE-2026-96889). The prebuilt sharp-libvips 1.3.4 artifacts include patched librsvg 2.63.2. Miniflare 4.20260430.0, used directly and by Wrangler 4.87.0, still requests vulnerable sharp ^0.34.5; remove this override when the dependency graph requires a patched release.
overridesRationale.bash-language-server: Vendored to keep shell language support while preserving a clean high-severity audit surface for the bundled Bash LSP dependency graph.
overridesRationale.fast-xml-parser: Pinned to the audited 5.x parser release used by transitive Google/Cloud tooling.
overridesRationale.fast-uri: Require 3.1.9 or later to close GHSA-w74x-v6f9-j3xg and GHSA-wjr9-j795-jxcr (scheme spoofing and host confusion) and the low GHSA-xhq7-xmqj-769h and GHSA-333x-w4r6-6crp, across the AJV consumers used by ESLint and API Extractor.
overridesRationale.google-auth-library: Pinned to an audited release for Cloudflare/Wrangler transitive auth tooling.
overridesRationale.minimatch: Require 11.0.1 or later to close GHSA-g3hv-75wg-m249 (denial of service via globparts amplification; no fixed 10.x release) across API Extractor, ESLint, typescript-eslint and eslint-plugin-jsx-a11y.
overridesRationale.esbuild: Pinned to 0.28.1 to close GHSA-gv7w-rqvm-qjhr (missing binary integrity verification in Deno module, enabling RCE via NPM_CONFIG_REGISTRY). Wrangler 4.x pins esbuild <0.28.1; this override forces the patched release across all transitive consumers.
overridesRationale.form-data: Pinned to 4.0.6 to close GHSA-hmw2-7cc7-3qxx (CRLF injection via unescaped multipart field/file names). Forces the patched release across remaining transitive consumers.
overridesRationale.ws: Pinned to 8.21.0 to close GHSA-96hv-2xvq-fx4p (memory-exhaustion DoS from tiny fragments). Minor bump within the 8.x line forced across miniflare, node-edge-tts, and the openai ws peer.
overridesRationale.undici: Require 7.30.1 to close GHSA-xjj6-f33q-929c (an unhandled body-stream error can crash fetch callers). Keep the compatible 7.x line used by jsdom and miniflare.
overridesRationale.ip-address: Require 10.7.4 or later to close GHSA-rxp7-6hxx-x8q5 (an IPv6 zone identifier matched in quadratic time ahead of the length limit) for the direct use and every transitive consumer.
